name: Classic Yellow
tagline: The timeless companion for every bath.
description: Classic Yellow has perfected the art of calm floating and brings reassuring cheer to baths of every size.

name: Captain Quack
tagline: Ready to navigate the stormiest soap bubbles.
description: Captain Quack charts daring courses between shampoo bottles and never abandons a crewmate in rough water.

name: Professor Paddles
tagline: A thoughtful duck for your toughest debugging sessions.
description: Professor Paddles listens carefully to complex problems and offers a well-timed squeak when the solution becomes obvious.

name: Disco Duck
tagline: Brings sparkling energy to the tub.
description: Disco Duck turns an ordinary soak into a celebration and always knows when the chorus is about to begin.

name: Astro Quacker
description: Astro Quacker trains for zero-gravity ponds while studying every mysterious corner of the bathroom universe.

name: Chef Waddles
tagline: Serves up a perfectly seasoned soak.
description: Chef Waddles believes every bath deserves careful preparation, balanced bubbles, and a tasteful finishing splash.

name: Pirate Peep
tagline: Searching every bathtub for buried treasure.
description: Pirate Peep explores beyond the faucet in search of legendary treasure and the perfect patch of foam.

name: Tiny Tux
tagline: Always dressed for a formal float.
description: Tiny Tux brings impeccable manners and understated charm to every formal bath-time occasion.

name: Doctor Duck
tagline: Prescribes warm water and plenty of bubbles.
description: Doctor Duck makes thoughtful rounds, checks the water temperature, and recommends rest after strenuous splashing.

name: Retro Ruby
tagline: A bold red twist on an old favorite.
description: Retro Ruby combines vintage bath-time style with a bright personality that never fades into the background.
